title: Make alembic_plan a stateless precondition run before EACH cold-start/deep-scan/module-scan: draft returns only a byte-budget-bounded projectInfoTree pyramid (64KB stop-point) + all candidate dimensions with miningGuidance; Agent selects dimensions+scale for that one stage; confirm validates (no re-analysis, no DB) and returns single-stage planSelection; bootstrap/rescan require planSelection (gate storage-read deleted). DELETE the whole plan persistence layer (plans table/migration 012/PlanRepository/PlanLedgerService persistence/get/signature/version); RELOCATE the pure coverage-projection engine to a Recipe-domain module; git-diff checkpoint seeds from current HEAD; SOP+missionBriefing become fixed bindings from selected dimensions at generation. Developer-decision strict spec with per-field/interface/deletion/rewire file:line + per-phase pass criteria. Fixes the live 4.5MB draft. Supersedes pure-collection; reverses recipe-evolution plan-persistence.
stateReason: Archive completed stateless plan precondition contract before claiming the next coldstart-chain repair demand.

taskPackages.summary: P0 producer task for strict stateless alembic_plan contract. In AlembicCore, delete the plan persistence layer and relocate/preserve the pure projection engine exactly as Design/docs/current/alembic-plan-stateless-precondition-contract-2026-06-24.md specifies. This is a source-owner task, not an implementation redesign: remove PlanRepository/plans migration/schema/repository wiring, extract single-stage plan intent validation primitives, relocate plan generation-state/coverage projection to a Recipe-domain module, and prepare GitDiffCheckpointService for current-HEAD baseline wiring if it is Core-owned in this phase. Do not keep plan persistence under a new name; do not delete the projection engine; do not change public semantics beyond the strict deletion/relocation/rewire contract. Evidence must include commit hash, exact rg/import sweep results, build/typecheck/lint/test commands, and file-level notes proving Section 2 deletion + Section 3 preserve/relocate compliance.

P0 consumer task for the strict stateless alembic_plan contract after Core commit 38d074fa64a014ef458044cac7881e092c0c6b8d was accepted. In AlembicPlugin, remove all production references to deleted Core plan persistence and make the Plugin compile against the new Core stateless/recipeStatus/checkpoint primitives. This includes removing planRepository DI from InfraModule/ServiceMap, deleting storage reads/calls to PlanRepository/getPlanView/saveDraft/getActiveConfirmed, and rewiring GitDiffCheckpoint routing away from planRepository toward a current HEAD baseline provider. Do not keep plan persistence under a new name, do not add a global field bag, do not implement fake storage-backed get, and do not silently degrade checkpoint baseline to empty. If deleting residuals requires P1/P2/P3 work, do only the minimal P0-compatible compile-safe seam or return blocked with exact file:line evidence.

P1 strict stateless draft task. Implement the alembic_plan draft contract from Design/docs/current/alembic-plan-stateless-precondition-contract-2026-06-24.md Section 1.2/1.4/P1 after P0 Core+Plugin deletion accepted. Draft must be stateless and return only the clean base plus projectInfoTree, candidateDimensions, agentDecisionChecklist, and nextActions. Build projectInfoTree as the byte-budget-bounded ProjectContext pyramid with default 64KB stop point, breadth-first by L0/L1/L2/L3, truthful meta.truncated/deliveredDepth/omitted. candidateDimensions must be all 25 registry dimensions with id,label,layer,languageApplicable,miningGuidance=d.extractionGuide only. Edit alembic_plan output allow-list accordingly and remove old draft output leaks: plan/planState/planView/planningBrief/sourceReports/projectContextCreationGuide/projectContextSignature/currentProjectContextSignature/signature/presenterInput/envelopes/missionBriefing/onboardingContract/sop/analysisGuide/submissionSpec/matchTopics/weight. No persistence, no global field bag, no recommendation/top/fallback/subset/ranking. If a Core tree accessor is truly required and absent, return blocked with exact file:line and minimal required Core API instead of inventing a replacement.

P2 AlembicPlugin: implement the strict stateless single-stage alembic_plan confirm -> planSelection contract from the 2026-06-24 developer-decision design. Scope is confirm only, after accepted P0/P1. confirm must read no draft, write no row, not call/recollect ProjectContext, and use projectProfile carried in the input. Adapt the preserved single-stage validateCompletePlanIntent path, normalize/validate selected dimensions, reject incomplete payloads with explicit field errors, and return only base/status confirmed plus planSelection { generationStage, dimensions, scale { totalRecipeBudget, maxFiles, contentMaxLines, depthLevels }, moduleBindings }. Forbidden: any plan persistence under any name, any planId/version/signature/supersede, stages{} or perStage, hidden global bag, output SOP/missionBriefing/sourceReports/planningBrief/projectContextCreationGuide, or re-analysis during confirm.

P3 strict executor wiring package for AlembicPlugin. Preconditions: P0 Core+Plugin, P1 draft, and P2 confirm have controller acceptance. Scope is only P3 from the strict design: require a single-stage stateless planSelection on alembic_bootstrap and alembic_rescan, delete any remaining gate storage-read/routePlanTool path, make gate selectors read the passed planSelection dimensions/moduleBindings/scale, validate planSelection at gate entry with a PLAN_REQUIRED-style refusal pointing to alembic_plan, and forward planSelection through the alembic_job bootstrap/rescan path. Do not implement P4 checkpoint/SOP/missionBriefing derivation or P5 real-project e2e in this package unless a tiny compile-only adjustment is unavoidable and explicitly backfilled.

P3 rework for AlembicPlugin. Fix only the controller-found stage compatibility gap in executor planSelection validation. Keep the accepted P3 work from commit be21205, but make bootstrap reject non-coldStart planSelection and make rescan reject coldStart planSelection; resolvePlanGenerationGate must compare planSelection.generationStage against the executor/requested/default stage instead of letting planSelection override the tool stage. Add regression tests and rerun the P3 validation set. Do not implement P4 checkpoint/SOP/missionBriefing or P5 BiliDili e2e.

P4 Core producer package for the strict stateless plan contract. Rewire GitDiffCheckpointService away from deleted plan persistence to a getBaselineCommit(projectRoot) provider that returns current git HEAD; when HEAD exists the baseline source must be current-head, never empty. Keep Recipe projection relocation from P0 intact and keep getDimensionSOP/buildProjectContextMissionBriefing available for Plugin generation-time derivation. Do not implement Plugin route wiring or P5 Test e2e in this package.

P4 Plugin consumer package for the strict stateless plan contract. Consume AlembicCore commit 1bac46009524e03ce6b90bf69367a608613c750c by wiring DurableGitDiffCheckpointRouting / git-diff checkpoint construction to Core's current HEAD baseline provider instead of any deleted active confirmed Plan path; also ensure generation derives SOP via getDimensionSOP(dim, language) and missionBriefing via buildProjectContextMissionBriefing from planSelection.dimensions at generation time, while alembic_plan output remains free of SOP/missionBriefing. Do not implement P5 BiliDili e2e or test-window validation in this package.

P5 final Test package for the strict alembic_plan stateless precondition contract after P0-P4 Core/Plugin packages are accepted. Validate the real-project BiliDili scenario against the exact design completion definition: stateless alembic_plan draft -> confirm -> bootstrap/rescan(planSelection), compact draft payload, no plan persistence, and no SOP/missionBriefing in plan output. This package is Test-only real-scenario evidence; do not edit product code or create product fixes.

P5 rework: repair Core runtime/build artifact residue that still ships deleted plan persistence. Test raw evidence from BiliDili shows fresh runtime DB applies 012_plans and creates the forbidden plans table because AlembicCore/dist still contains dist/infrastructure/database/migrations/012_plans.js and dist/repository/plan/PlanRepository.js. Keep the strict stateless precondition contract unchanged; do not reintroduce persistence under another name.

P5 retest after accepted AlembicCore dist-residue repair. Re-run the BiliDili stateless plan e2e using AlembicCore commit 9fa3b0f025dd063d59d757b1eac0e6f73cfbff93 and rebuilt Core dist so final P5 can be accepted or rejected on fresh raw evidence.
